verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken lower half: the flavour chips are staggered at random (Blood Orange alone on its own row, the other two offset to the right), the CTA floats right-aligned and detached from the left-aligned copy, the legal text is tiny, and there is a dead band at the bottom. In A, the logo (x≈88), headline (x≈38) and subtitle (x≈70) start at three different left edges, and a large gap separates the headline from its subtitle. B lines up the logo and headline on one edge and keeps the headline and subtitle together, though its subtitle is still slightly out of line with them.
